abasement, humiliation, low estate: Luk.1:48, Act.8:33" (LXX), Php.3:21, Jas.1:10 (Plat., Arist., and later writers).†

elsewhere.note: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things…
